links.outcome: Reviewer accuracy, agreement and review time with versus without LLM assistance
links.effect: LLM-assisted workflow improved accuracy (F1 = 0.88 vs 0.77), Cohen's kappa (0.82 vs 0.50), and reduced average review time by approximately half.
links.quote: Compared with unassisted manual review, the LLM-assisted workflow improved accuracy (F1 = 0.88 vs 0.77), inter-rater agreement measured by Cohen's kappa (kappa = 0.82 vs 0.50), and reduced average review time by approximately half.
